title: Uniform amenability at infinity
summary: We introduce the notion of uniform exactness, or uniform amenability at infinity, for discrete groups and prove it for a wide class of groups containing free groups and their limit groups. This shows a novel strong convergence phenomenon that any convergent sequence of such groups in the space of marked groups converges strongly in the operator algebraic sense. In particular, convergence of the spectral radius formula is uniform over probability measures on such groups whose supports have a fixed cardinality.
